scope: Only static cuboid swept-sphere narrow phase. Source projectile radius is supplied by the caller; this implementation does not claim a recovered original engine collision algorithm.

api.result: Hit(fraction,center,point,normal), or null on no contact
api.corners: Bit order X=1,Y=2,Z=4: origin,+X,+Y,+X+Y,+Z,+X+Z,+Y+Z,+X+Y+Z. These are transformed local edges, not world AABB extremes. Corners must form an affine cuboid; planar/linear/point degeneracy is supported.
api.boxAdapter: HydraContact.Box.points is a 27-point x-major/y/z grid. Corner indices in the required bit order are [0,18,6,24,2,20,8,26].

mathBoundary: For a fixed convex cuboid K, a sphere of radius r touches iff its center belongs to K plus the Euclidean ball B(r). First entry from outside belongs to an offset face patch, finite edge cylinder or vertex sphere.

The helper enumerates all six finite face patches at signed plane distance +/-r, twelve finite edge cylinders and eight vertex spheres. Both plane signs retain degenerate planar boxes. Full edge/vertex primitives introduce no false earlier entry: every accepted candidate has an actual point of K within r plus tolerance.

Quadratic roots use closest-line projection: t0=-dot(offset,travel)/|travel|^2 and t=t0 +/- sqrt((r^2-distanceToLine^2)/|travel|^2), avoiding subtraction of large discriminant terms. Edge axial bounds and face parallelogram coordinates reject infinite-feature extensions.

Initial solid containment or distance <= r returns fraction 0 and the nearest actual surface point. Zero radius, stationary segments and end-of-segment contacts have defined behavior. For nonzero separated first contact, normal is the actual contact-point-to-center unit vector.
Returns the least valid fraction in [0,1]. There is no per-tick sampling, iterative convergence stop or inflated-AABB narrow-phase result.

numerics.arithmetic: double, near-origin coordinates relative to corner 0
numerics.candidateCheck: Every candidate is clamped to segment endpoints and checked again against an actual cuboid point at radius + spatialTolerance. A near tangent within this tolerance counts as touching.
numerics.limits: Affine input corner consistency allows four spatial tolerances. Nonfinite inputs/derived squared distances, face areas or volume are rejected with IllegalArgumentException. Features beneath floating-point representation or extreme ill-conditioning are limited by the supplied corner precision; no exact-arithmetic claim is made.
numerics.normalization: Uses explicit division instead of Minecraft Vec3.normalize, whose small-vector cutoff would collapse normals of thin faces.
numerics.pose: One static receiving pose per call. Continuous motion/deformation of the receiver, world queries, loaded chunks, ownership, PvP and candidate ordering remain caller responsibilities.
